help.richText: Formatting: ## Heading, - bullet list, 1. numbered list, **bold**, *italic* and [link text](https://…).
help.heroImage: Use a wide image, ideally 2400 pixels or more.
help.overlay: Darkens the image so white text is easier to read.
help.keyFigures: Figures taken from the units update automatically when status and price change.
help.useProjectMilestones: The milestones are edited in the project settings.
help.selector: Only this project's selectors can be chosen. It appears on the page once published.
help.entryView: The view visitors see first, such as a facade.
help.useProjectLocation: The address and location are edited in the project settings.
help.places: For example schools, shops and public transport.
help.documents: PDFs from the media library. They open in a new tab.
help.video: YouTube or Vimeo. The video only loads when the visitor clicks.
help.news: Newest first. News items with a date are sorted by date.
help.embed: The address must start with https://. The content is shown in a restricted frame.
help.embedTitle: Read out by screen readers, for example «3D tour of apartment A-302».
help.pageSlug: Shown in the address after the domain, for example /location.
help.seoTitle: Leave empty to use the page title.
help.seoDescription: Short text shown in search results, preferably under 160 characters.
help.shareImage: Shown when the page is shared on social media. Without one, the hero image is used.
help.menu: The menu is shown at the top of every page. Links to blocks point to blocks on the home page.
help.footerText: For example company name, address and organisation number.
help.siteLogo: Leave empty to use the organisation's logo.
help.siteDescription: Used in search results for pages without their own description.
help.siteShareImage: Used when a page is shared and neither the page nor its hero block has an image.
help.useProjectContacts: The contacts are edited in the project settings.
help.brandLogo: Shown at the top of the project sites. A PNG with a transparent background works well.
help.privacyController: The company responsible for the information from the interest form. If left empty, the organization's name is used.
help.privacyEmail: Visitors can write here for access and deletion. If left empty, the email of the first contact person is used.
help.privacyExtra: Your own text at the bottom of the privacy page, for example about other processing. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

image.unknown: The image is not in the media library

consent.title: Cookies
consent.text: We would like to use cookies for analytics and marketing. We only do so if you accept. Necessary features, such as the interest form and favorites, work regardless.
consent.necessaryHelp: remembers your choice and your favorites. Always on.
consent.statisticsHelp: shows us how the site is used, so we can improve it.
consent.marketingHelp: measures ads and shows you relevant ads elsewhere.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains how {controller} processes personal data on the website for {project}.
privacy.contactAt: Questions about privacy can be sent to
privacy.collected: When you register interest in {project}, we store your name, email address, phone number and message, which home you are interested in, when you sent the form, and which version of the consent text you accepted. If you came from an ad or campaign, we also store the campaign.
privacy.purpose: We use the information to contact you about {project}. If you have also consented to it, we may contact you about similar projects. The legal basis is your consent (GDPR Article 6(1)(a)).
privacy.retentionTitle: How long the information is kept
privacy.retentionDays: The information is deleted automatically after {days} days, or earlier if you ask.
privacy.retentionUntilDeleted: The information is kept until you ask for it to be deleted, or until it is no longer needed.
privacy.processors: The information is stored in the EU (Stockholm). The providers that run the website and send email process the information only on behalf of {controller}.
privacy.tracking: If you consent, the website uses {tools}. You can change your consent at any time.
privacy.noTracking: The website does not use tools for analytics or marketing.
privacy.rights: You can ask for access to, correction of and deletion of the information about you, and you can withdraw your consent at any time. Contact {controller}.
privacy.complaint: If you believe the information is processed incorrectly, you can complain to

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: Cookies and similar storage in the browser are used to remember your choices and, if you consent, for analytics and marketing.
cookies.consentNeeded: Analytics and marketing are only used if you consent. You can change your consent at any time.
cookies.noConsentNeeded: The website only uses storage needed for it to work, so you do not need to consent.
cookies.name: Name
cookies.favoritesPurpose: Remembers your favorites in the unit selector. Stored only in your browser.
cookies.gaPurpose: Google Analytics: tells visitors apart for analytics.
cookies.gtmPurpose: Google Tag Manager: loads analytics and marketing tools according to what you have consented to.
cookies.pixelPurpose: Meta Pixel: measures ads on Facebook and Instagram.
cookies.turnstile: The interest form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to stop spam. Turnstile can read technical information about your browser when you send the form.
cookies.privacyLink: Read how personal data is processed

domains.title: Custom domains
domains.description: Give the project sites their own domain, for example www.fjordparken.no. You add two DNS records with your domain provider. The domain is verified automatically, and the HTTPS certificate is created for you.
domains.vercelMissing: Vercel is not connected in this environment. Domains are verified with DNS lookups, but the certificate must be set up in Vercel.
domains.noSites: No projects have a project site yet. Create a project site first, then you can give it a custom domain.
domains.unpublished: The project site is not published yet.
domains.clearPrimary: Use the subdomain as the main address
domains.primarySet: {hostname} is now the primary domain. Other addresses send visitors there.
domains.primaryCleared: The subdomain is now the main address.
domains.removeBody: The domain is removed from the project site. You can delete the DNS records with your provider.
domains.removeVerifiedBody: The project site stops answering on this domain right away. Links to the domain will no longer work.
domains.verifiedHelp: The domain is verified and shows the project site. The HTTPS certificate is created automatically, usually within a few minutes.
domains.verifiedPrimaryHelp: The domain is verified and is the project site's main address. The subdomain and other domains send visitors here.
domains.warning: The last check found a problem, but the domain is still in use: {message}

errors.txt_missing: The TXT record was not found. Add it with your domain provider. DNS changes can take a while to show up.
errors.dns_not_pointing: Ownership is verified, but the domain does not point to the platform yet. Check the CNAME or A record.
errors.vercel_verification: The domain is in use on another Vercel account. Also add the TXT record marked “Vercel”.
errors.vercel_unavailable: Could not reach Vercel. Try again in a moment.
errors.lookup_failed: The DNS lookup failed. Try again in a moment.
errors.hostname_taken: The domain is already in use on another project site.

records.help: Add the records with your domain provider. Some providers want the name without the domain at the end, for example “www” instead of “www.fjordparken.no”.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Give other systems, such as broker systems, access to projects, units and leads. The key is shown only once, when it is created.
keys.createHelp: Give the key a name that says where it is used, and only the permissions the system needs.
keys.createdHelp: The key will not be shown again. Store it where the system that uses it can read it.
keys.name: Name
keys.revokeBody: The key stops working right away. Systems using it will get errors until they get a new key.

scopeHelp.units_read: read all units, including hidden ones, with external id
scopeHelp.units_write: change status and price on units

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Notifies other systems when a unit changes status or someone registers interest. Every delivery is signed, and failed deliveries are retried for about two hours.
webhooks.createHelp: The address must use https. Events are sent as JSON with POST.
webhooks.createdHelp: Use the secret to verify the signature on every delivery. You can show it again later.
webhooks.failures: {count, plural, one {# failure in a row} other {# failures in a row}}
webhooks.secretHelp: The signature follows Standard Webhooks (standardwebhooks.com): the headers webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature.
webhooks.rotated: A new secret has been created. The old one no longer works.
webhooks.testFailed: The test event was not delivered (HTTP {status}). {error}
webhooks.deleteBody: {url} will get no more events. Pending deliveries are deleted too.

eventHelp.unit_status_changed: a unit gets a new status

reference.title: About the API
reference.description: The API is for server-to-server use. Responses are JSON. The limit is 600 calls per minute per key.
reference.auth: Send the key in the header
reference.open: Open to everyone, published data only (CORS).

endpoints.projects: The projects in the organization, with the number of units per status.
endpoints.units: All units in a project. “updated_since” returns only changed units.
endpoints.updateUnit: Change status (with a note) and price on a unit, given by id or unit number.
endpoints.leads: Leads, oldest first. Use “since” and “project_id” to fetch new ones.
endpoints.publicSelector: A published unit selector with units and status.
endpoints.publicUnits: The units in a published project.

reference.webhooksSignature: Webhooks are signed according to Standard Webhooks. Use a Standard Webhooks library, or compute HMAC-SHA256 with the secret over the values of webhook-id and webhook-timestamp and the body, separated by dots.
